skirt = a piece of clothing that hangs from the waist and is not trousers
dress = a piece of clothing for a woman or girl that covers the body in one piece
jeans = trousers made of strong blue cotton
leggings = tight trousers made of stretchy material
shorts = trousers that end above the knee
socks = soft coverings for the feet, worn inside shoes
boots = shoes that cover the ankle or more
sandals = open shoes for warm weather
slippers = soft shoes you wear only indoors
coat = a piece of clothing you wear over other clothes outdoors
jacket = a short coat
scarf = a long piece of cloth worn around the neck
gloves = coverings for the hands with separate fingers
hat = something you wear on your head
cap = a soft hat with a stiff peak at the front
belt = a strip of leather or cloth worn around the waist
pockets = small bags sewn into clothes for carrying things
striped = with a pattern of lines
spotted = with a pattern of round marks
plain = without a pattern
